title: Lemon Pepper
method: Preheat the oven to 120°C/100°C fan (250°F), Gas Mark 1/2.
Line a baking tray with baking parchment and finely grate the zest of all 3 lemons directly on to it until you have removed all the zest.

Place on the middle shelf of the oven for 40 minutes — check on it after 30 minutes to make sure it isn't browning. The zest should be crisp to the touch but not burned or browned. Remove from the oven and tip the zest into a small bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in a jam jar or other airtight container for up to 1 year.
notes: Use in Chicken Lemon Pepperpot (p.31) or as a stand-alone seasoning for chicken, fish, beef, potato wedges, roast cauliflower, pasta salad or green vegetables. Calories stated are per tablespoon.
